def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", *args], cwd=root, text=True, timeout=20
    ).strip()


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode()).hexdigest()


def save(path, report, first=False):
    data = (json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()
    assert len(data) <= 16 * 1024 * 1024, "Diagnostic report exceeds 16 MiB disk budget"
    if first:
        with path.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(data)
    else:
        staged = path.with_suffix(".pending")
        staged.write_bytes(data)
        staged.replace(path)

    report = {"scope":"Untimed inspected-input causal diagnosis, no admission or performance claim", "base_commit":BASE,"implementation_commit":git(ROOT,"rev-parse","HEAD"),"source_commit":HARNESS,"rejected_source_commit":"0692118febfd7a8f5e3ee17ee32121fc913d494c","driver_source":Path(__file__).read_text(),"rows":[]}

    for width,family,topology in ((6,"repetition","ring"),(8,"qft","sparse"),(12,"qaoa","grid"),(12,"qft","sparse"),(12,"repetition","sparse")):
        source=fixture(width,family,topology,"01"*32)
        key=f"{width:02d}/{family}/{topology}"
        for workflow in WORKFLOWS:
            for variant in ("baseline","candidate"):
                captures=[]
                def capture(ir, topology_cost, **kwargs):
                    result=actual_router(ir,topology_cost,**kwargs)
                    plan=kwargs.get("plan")
                    forward=[(op.name,op.wires,op.metadata.get("source_instruction_index"),op.metadata.get("routing_phase")) for op in result if op.metadata.get("routing_phase")!="final_restore"]
                    restore=[op.wires for op in result if op.metadata.get("routing_phase")=="final_restore"]
                    captures.append({"source_content_hash":ir.content_hash,"strategy":kwargs["strategy"],"forward_sha256":digest(forward),"forward_operations":len(forward),"restore_swaps":restore,"plan":dataclasses.asdict(plan) if plan is not None else None})
                    return result
                configuration=workflow_configuration(workflow)
                adapter=load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={"options":{"sdk":configuration["sdk"],"workflow":workflow,"compiler_options":deepcopy(configuration)}}))
                with ExitStack() as stack:
                    stack.enter_context(patch.object(routing_entry,"_route_sabre",capture))
                    if variant=="candidate": stack.enter_context(patch.object(sabre,"restore_swaps",candidate.restore_swaps))
                    payload=adapter.execute("route",deepcopy(source),11)
                checksum=digest({k:payload[k] for k in ("operations","final_layout")})
                ref=reference[key,workflow,variant]
                assert checksum==ref["payload_sha256"] and dict(adapter.audit)==ref["audit"]
                metrics=routing(payload,source,None,Bundle(HROOT/"docs/implementation").cases["ROUTE-GRID-08" if width==8 else f"ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}"],0)
                assert metrics==ref["metrics"]
                report["rows"].append({"case":key,"workflow":workflow,"variant":variant,"metrics":metrics,"payload_sha256":checksum,"captures":captures})
                print(key,workflow,variant,len(captures),flush=True)
    report["completed"]=True
    save(Path("/private/tmp/fq-restoration-selection-diagnosis-20261123.json"),report,first=True)
